error[L0315]: this argument is passed `inout`, so the call may change its storage while `slot` still views it

14 |     try vec.push(values, memory, 4)
   |                  ^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/generic-borrow-checked-at-instance/main.ldn:10:5

   |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the live derived view
  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `value` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; finish with `slot` before the call and take it again after, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `value` without `inout`
